title: At the Beach Unit Study Parts 1 & 2 (Stephanie Hathaway Designs)
dropperComment: love art work and involvement of different disciplines and subjects through one theme. Lots of information and activities. Grade level elementary and below.

unmappedSkills.description: Identify and classify seashore animals (seahorse, crabs, jellyfish, starfish, lobster, clam, sea urchin, etc.)
Identify parts of a wave (peak, crest, lip, spray, barrel, wall, shoulder)
Identify parts of a jellyfish (bell, gonads, oral arms, lappets, mouth)
Understand what sand is made of and how erosion creates it
Locate beaches on a globe/map, explore beach geography
Cultural significance of seashells throughout history
Read, recite, and appreciate classic poetry (Robert Louis Stevenson)
Study classic paintings by theme (Van Gogh, Mary Cassatt, Hokusai, Munch)

printFormat.colorRequirement: many pages need color for full impact

gaps: cross-curricular-unit-study: theme-based study spanning 5+ disciplines (science, math, social studies, language arts, art) with teacher guide, reading list, video list, supply list, and 30+ activity pages
naturalist-identification-poster: watercolor illustration of 15+ species with numbered labels and word bank
3-part-nomenclature-cards: Montessori-style matching cards (image + label, image only, label only) for vocabulary building
art-appreciation-cards: classic artwork reproduction with artist bio, dates, style label — for art history integration
copy-work-pages: handwriting practice using curated quotes/poems with illustration — print and cursive versions
nature-journal-prompts: guided observation and recording templates for field work

components.name: Teacher/Parent Guide (6+ pages)
components.description: Comprehensive guide covering: unit study goals, reading list (10+ books with ISBNs), documentary/video list, supply list, and discipline-specific activity suggestions for science, math, social studies, language arts, and art.

components.name: Seashore Animals Poster
components.description: 17 watercolor-illustrated species with numbered labels and word bank. Museum-quality naturalist art.

components.name: Species Detail Cards (4-up)
components.description: Individual species illustrations in 2x2 grid with common name + Latin scientific name. Watercolor art.

components.name: 3-Part Nomenclature Cards
components.description: Montessori-style matching cards: watercolor illustration + label (printed in pairs for cutting). Multiple sets covering crabs, shells, jellyfish, sea creatures.

components.name: Anatomy Diagrams
components.description: Labeled anatomy illustrations (wave anatomy, jellyfish anatomy) with word bank versions for fill-in labeling activities. Watercolor style.

components.name: Letter Pages
components.description: Full-page uppercase B and lowercase b outlines with beach scene illustration. Cross-curricular Pre-K inclusion.

components.name: Copy Work / Handwriting
components.description: Dotted-line tracing pages with beach vocabulary (tide pool, etc.) and full-sentence copy work. Three-line handwriting guide.

components.name: Poetry Page
components.description: 'At the Sea-Side' by Robert Louis Stevenson — full poem with watercolor shell illustration.

components.name: Art Study Cards
components.description: 4 classic paintings: Van Gogh 'Dunes' (1882, Realism), Mary Cassatt 'Children Playing On The Beach' (1885, Impressionism), plus Hokusai and Munch. Each card has artwork reproduction + artist bio + style label.

components.name: Various Activity Pages
components.description: Sensory play suggestions, shell measuring math activity, world map for geography, and more.

notes: 70 pages across two PDFs. Same creator as the Heart study (Stephanie Hathaway Designs). This is the cross-curricular model — one theme (the beach) woven through science, math, social studies, language arts, and art. Carolyng's comment specifically calls out 'involvement of different disciplines and subjects through one theme' — that's the unit study methodology she values. The art history cards are a distinctive feature: classic paintings (Van Gogh, Cassatt, Hokusai, Munch) connected to the beach theme with artist bios. The Montessori 3-part nomenclature cards signal Charlotte Mason / Montessori methodology overlap. The watercolor naturalist illustration style is consistent with the Heart study — Carolyng clearly gravitates toward this creator's aesthetic.
